from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashFlowItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash flow line item extracted from one company's financial filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to, as written in the document")
    activity_type: str | None = Field(description="The category of cash flow (e.g., 'investing', 'financing', 'operating')")
    activity_description: str | None = Field(description="The specific label or description of the line item as written")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary value reported; use sign to indicate inflow vs outflow (e.g. negative for 'used')")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale or unit of the amount if specified (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period the figure covers")
    quote: str = Field(description="A verbatim excerpt from the document containing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_flow_items: list[CashFlowItem]
